data.name: Amshar
data.gender_notes: Amshar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who loves the moon, the one who is protected by God and the one who is a guardian. The name Amshar carries the meaning “Lover of the Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Amshar usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are spiritually connected to the moon and its cycles, offering protection and guardianship
data.etymology: Amshar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of the Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amshar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

The name "Amshar" may be a reminder of the importance of appreciating natural phenomena and staying connected to the rhythms of the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, the name "Amshar" is a reflection of the love and protection of the Almighty. The first part of the name, 'Am', comes from the Arabic word for 'God'; while the second part, 'Shar', means 'guardian'. Being called 'Amshar' places an emphasis on one's relationship with God as both lover and protector, and as someone who is being watched over and cared for. It underscores the significance of seeking God's love and guidance in all aspects of life, while also recognizing the role of God as a defender and guardian of His creation.
